locations.note: The story opens aboard HMS Victoria during a mission around Antarctica and a rescue from a secret German base.
Ryan's journey takes him to the Falkland Islands before reaching Buenos Aires.
A chapter takes Lt. Ryan to Buenos Aires, including the city's library, before the Antarctic expedition continues.
Captured in Buenos Aires, Ryan wakes in a cell at Schlossadler, the Nazis' Eagle Castle, and must break out before Dietrich completes his ritual with the Necronomicon.
The last chapter leaps a century ahead: Ryan is carried to Illsmouth in 2037, to the hall of the sorcerer Narackamous.

routes.name: Ryan's journey
routes.note: Lt. Ryan goes from a mission around Antarctica via the Falklands and Buenos Aires to a Nazi castle in the Bavarian Alps, then a century ahead to Illsmouth.
